test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Warner starts from Point A and drives 78 km towards the west. He then takes a right turn, drives 79 km, turns right and drives 80 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 90 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

→ Warner starts from Point A.

→ Drives 78 km towards west.

→ Turns right and drives 79 km.

→ Turns right and drives 80 km.

→ Turns right and drives 90 km.

→ Turns right and drives 2 km to reach Point P.

**Step-by-step movement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8e113ba046328e4a8c8b796ac8e1825a55d2bb0bddbdb0dd0d2bef38d89e8c5.png] 

If P is 11 km south of A, then Warner must move **11 km north** to reach A.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3 — 11 km to the north**.
